name: policy-pilot
description: Ask your HR handbook anything: retrieval-augmented answers with citations, hybrid search and an evaluation harness.
author: Zaid Nayeem

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,blue "npm run dev -w @policypilot/server" "VITE_ENGINE=server npm run dev -w @policypilot/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
scripts.lint: oxlint packages/core/src packages/core/scripts apps/server/src apps/web/src e2e
